AboutTagline: A modern image converter focused on batch workflows and output quality.
AboutSummary: Imvix is designed to provide stable, efficient, and controllable image conversion in a clean desktop experience. It fits format conversion, batch compression, resizing, automatic renaming, and folder-watch workflows.
AboutFeatureSectionBody:
1. Supports import and export for PNG, JPG, JPEG, WEBP, BMP, GIF, TIFF, ICO, and SVG.
2. Includes batch import, folder import, drag-and-drop intake, and list management.
3. Provides compression tuning, resize rules, batch rename, SVG background handling, presets, and failure logs.
4. Includes recent conversion history, smart format recommendations, and output size estimation.
5. Supports folder watch mode to process newly added images automatically with the current settings.
AboutTechSectionBody:
1. Built on .NET 10 for the core desktop application.
2. Uses Avalonia UI 11 for the cross-platform desktop interface and theme resources.
3. Uses CommunityToolkit.Mvvm for state, commands, and interaction flow.
4. Combines Skia-based graphics, the SVG processing pipeline, and System.Drawing.Common for preview, analysis, and conversion work.
AboutIdeasSectionBody:
1. MVVM keeps the interface and business state structured for easier maintenance and expansion.
2. Import, analysis, warnings, conversion, summary, and logging are split into focused services to reduce coupling.
3. Presets, batch tasks, and watch mode turn repetitive actions into reusable workflows.
4. The default experience stays simple while advanced users still get precise control when needed.
GetProHeadline: Choose the right edition for your workflow
GetProSummary: Standard already covers everyday image conversion. Imvix Pro adds PDF, PSD, AI tools, OCR, and deeper Windows integration when you need a broader workflow.
GetProStandardBody: Best for daily image conversion, compression, resizing, renaming, presets, and folder watch.
GetProAccessBody: Imvix Pro is available for ongoing free use with no time limit and continues to be released as an open-source project. Purchasing through Microsoft Store is optional and serves as a direct way to support continued development and maintenance.
GetProProBody: Keeps all standard capabilities and adds document handling, AI tools, recognition workflows, and deeper Windows integration.
GetProMatrixSummary: These are the clearest differences you will feel in daily use.
GetProRowCoreBody: Import images in bulk, convert formats, compress, resize, rename, and export quickly.
GetProRowInsightBody: Get format suggestions, size estimates, transparency warnings, and compression reminders.
GetProRowWorkflowBody: Save repeated settings, review recent work, and process newly added images automatically.
GetProRowPdfBody: Handle PDF output, page ranges, split strategies, and flexible GIF frame extraction.
GetProRowAssetBody: Preview PSD files and extract icon resources from EXE or shortcut files.
GetProRowAiBody: Use local AI enhancement, background removal, object erasing, and preview workflows.
GetProRowRecognitionTitle: OCR, QR code, and barcode recognition
GetProRowRecognitionBody: Read text and code information from images, PDFs, or previewed results.
GetProRowWindowsBody: Bring Imvix further into daily Windows workflows with more system-level integration.
GetProDecisionBody: Choose Pro if your work includes PDF / PSD assets, AI enhancement, OCR, or Windows workflow integration. If you only need fast batch image conversion, Standard already covers the essentials.

VersionNotesSummary: This release focuses on layout adaptability, clearer guidance, and edition messaging. It improves the experience on low-resolution displays, clarifies supported import formats on the main window, and adds clearer access guidance for Imvix Pro.
VersionNotesImprovementsBody:
1. Added adaptive support for low-resolution screens to improve readability and layout stability in compact workspaces.
2. Refined the main-window guidance copy to clearly list supported import formats and reduce unnecessary guesswork during import.
VersionNotesEditionBody:
1. Added in-app edition guidance to help users understand the positioning of Standard and Pro more clearly.
2. Standard keeps a smaller package footprint for lightweight office workflows, while Pro includes a broader toolset suited to image-intensive work.
VersionNotesSupportBody:
1. Imvix Pro is now available for long-term download through Microsoft Store with an indefinite free trial.
2. If Imvix helps your workflow, purchasing Pro is a direct way to support continued maintenance and future updates.
